context_for_next_testing_agent: Clinic Settings Panel fully functional. Key endpoints: GET/PUT /api/clinic/settings (full clinic data including schedule, prescription settings), POST /api/clinic/settings/logo (logo upload to Supabase Storage), GET /api/clinic/members (members with emails from Supabase Auth), POST /api/clinic/members/invite (creates user in Supabase Auth + clinic_member record), PUT /api/clinic/members/:id (update member data including license_number), PUT /api/clinic/members/:id/toggle (activate/deactivate). Frontend route: /dashboard/configuracion with 5 tabs. Working days stored as array of ints [1,2,3,4,5]. Schedule times in HH:MM format. Plan limits: professional = max_users:10, max_patients:1000, max_storage_mb:5120.
